title: Hearing Leon Rappolo and the Brunies family
summary: He heard Rap with Paul Mares and mentions the Brunies brothers.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Oh, we can ask Raymond. Uh, what about rap? Did you hear him?

Yeah, I heard him rap play a few times. He was a wonderful clarinet man. He come down here, uh, played, uh, with Paul Moretz. He was playing with the Rhythm Kings then. And, uh, I heard him at the Italian Hall a couple of times in the French Union Hall. With, uh, they played benefits down there. With Paul Moretz was a trumpet man. Rap was clarinet. I think they had one of the Brunners on trombone, if I remember right. Either Merritt or...
I can't remember who they had on trombone.
I was a, uh, quite a youngster then. That's going way back. Uh-huh. That's, I was real young then. But I heard him play.
How many of the Brunners does he play? That's only a movie.
Oh, they got, they got two or three of them got a band right now in Biloxi. Merritt and, uh, in Georgia, I believe.
Abbott, yeah, Abbott. Abbey and Merritt.
